purpose: Require complete major-sport market evaluation before recommendation-card selection without lowering any Betting Edge execution, Core 1.4, personnel, price, exposure or staking gate.

feedAuthority.rule: Inspect fresh exact markets in events first. Supplemental deep collections may improve discovery but their absence does not prove that a prop market is unavailable.

props.leagueAvailabilityRule: NFL, NCAAF and CFL player-prop analysis is paused independently of feed availability.

propProcess.stage1: At or after reportScope.effectiveFrom, do not screen player props. Deterministic counting of fresh returned selection keys is inventory only, not handicap research.
propProcess.stage2: No prop matchup/personnel/model research and no new or carried prop BET, LEAN, WAIT or PASS cards while PAUSED_BY_SCOPE.
propProcess.identity: Retain Contract invariant 23 for archived props and any future explicitly activated prop category. This pause does not repair or waive exact identity.
propProcess.history: Before reportScope.effectiveFrom, retain the original full-prop-screening receipt rules. Preserve all issued reports and grading/history.

presentation.rule: The card target is applied only after complete market evaluation. A qualifying BET, LEAN or WAIT may not be suppressed solely to meet the target. PASS cards may be curated after complete evaluation.

rules: Use the current Git blob SHA of this authority file as coverageAudit.authorityBlobSha; never copy an older SHA.
Every sport key is present even when its game count is zero.
gamesEvaluated equals gamesInScope because checking an unavailable market is still an evaluation.
primary.required equals gamesInScope multiplied by six.
Every unavailable primary selection is represented exactly once in availabilityLimitations.

Before reportScope.effectiveFrom, props.screened equals props.returned. At/after that cutover, every sport has props.state=PAUSED_BY_SCOPE, screened=0, seriousDeepReviewed=0 and excludedByScope=returned; returned remains exact bound-feed inventory, not claimed analysis.
presentation.target equals the current repository report_card_target; targetIsSoft and overflowProtection are true and actionableSuppressedByTarget is zero.
Totals reconcile exactly with the sum of all sport entries.
complete is true only after the full active primary-market sweep precedes card selection; paused props do not make active-scope coverage incomplete.
Before staging, execute or reproduce the exact deterministic checks in tools/major-sport-market-coverage-gate.mjs; do not stage a candidate that would fail them.

At/after reportScope.effectiveFrom, coverageAudit.scope copies id, effectiveFrom and playerProps from reportScope. Totals include propsExcludedByScope, equal to propsReturned. These additive fields are not required on older reports.

At/after reportScope.effectiveFrom, every report and sidecar recommendation must identify an allowed sport and full-game primary market. Player-prop cards are forbidden in every status, including carried WAIT/LEAN and PASS.

completion.primaryCoverageComplete: Every in-scope game has every required primary selection evaluated or an explicit exact-market availability limitation recorded.
completion.propCoverageComplete: Before the scope cutover, every fresh exact supported prop was required to be screened. At/after the cutover, PAUSED_BY_SCOPE is explicit, zero props are analyzed, and returned inventory is reconciled to excludedByScope.
completion.reportCompletenessClaim: Claim complete coverage of the active full-game primary markets only when every required primary selection is evaluated or explicitly unavailable; state player-prop analysis is paused.

reportScope.reason: User-approved focus on full-game moneylines, primary spreads/run lines/puck lines and game totals while prop identity and screening are investigated.
reportScope.reactivationRule: Enable one exact prop category within one sport only after identity, book matching, research, screening and publication validation and an explicit scope amendment.
